📰 General

Pelicans, Rockets, Clippers, Suns, Blazers: Latest NBA Rumors Circulate Around Potential Trades •

The New Orleans Pelicans have reportedly fielded interest in forwards Trey Murphy III and Herbert Jones, with several teams expressing interest in potential trades. Initial reports suggest the Pelicans are open to discussing deals involving center Yves Missi and/or swingman Swidon Noah. Teams including the Rockets, Clippers, Suns, and Blazers have engaged in preliminary conversations regarding these players. These discussions highlight a potential shift in New Orleans’ approach to roster construction as they explore options for future acquisitions.

🌍 World

Gulf States and Turkey Lobby Trump to Avoid Military Strikes Against Iran •

Several Gulf states, including Saudi Arabia and Qatar, alongside Turkey and Oman, engaged in a coordinated effort to dissuade President Trump from initiating military strikes against Iran. The lobbying campaign stemmed from concerns that a U.S. attack would escalate into a widespread and prolonged conflict throughout the Middle East. These nations expressed fears about the potential for regional instability and the difficulty of resolving a major confrontation. Diplomatic pressure was exerted in the final moments before a planned announcement regarding potential action.

🦅 US

Harry Styles Announces New Album “Kiss All the Time,” Release Date Set •

Harry Styles is releasing his first album in four years, titled “Kiss All the Time,” scheduled for a March 6th release date via Columbia Records. The announcement details the album’s overall theme, incorporating elements of disco music. Styles has not yet released any tracks from the upcoming record. The album represents a significant project for the former One Direction member.

💰 Business

DOJ Launches Criminal Probe into Powell Over Fed Headquarters Costs •

The Department of Justice initiated a criminal investigation into Federal Reserve Chair Jerome Powell regarding alleged misrepresentations made to Congress concerning the cost of renovations at the Fed’s headquarters. The investigation stems from a January 11 announcement detailing the DOJ’s action. The probe centers on claims that Powell did not fully disclose the expenses associated with the building’s refurbishment project. This marks the first time a Fed chair has faced a criminal investigation while in office.

💻 Technology

Gmail Users Can Now Easily Change Email Addresses Without Account Deletion •

Google has introduced a streamlined process allowing users to modify their Gmail email address directly within the platform. Previously, users needed to create a new account and migrate their data, a cumbersome process. The new feature enables users to update their address without losing access to emails, contacts, and other associated data. Google provides a step-by-step guide within the Gmail settings to facilitate this change. This update simplifies the process for users seeking to consolidate their online identities.

🎭 Entertainment

Pamela Anderson Details Uncomfortable Encounter with Seth Rogen at 2026 Golden Globes •

Pamela Anderson discussed her experience being in close proximity to Seth Rogen at the 2026 Golden Globes. The conversation stemmed from Anderson’s prior discomfort regarding the Hulu series Pam & Tommy, which depicted her relationship with Tommy Lee. She explained that the situation triggered feelings of unease and a desire to avoid further association with Rogen. Anderson emphasized the personal nature of her reservations, stating she wished to maintain distance from the project’s subject matter.

🏅 Sports

Eagles Exploring Charlie Weis Jr. as Potential Offensive Coordinator Replacement •

The Philadelphia Eagles are reportedly considering LSU offensive coordinator Charlie Weis Jr. for the team’s open offensive coordinator role. According to a report by Pat Leonard of the New York Daily News, the Eagles have expressed interest in Weis Jr.’s offensive schemes. Weis Jr. currently leads the LSU offense, utilizing a spread attack. The team is seeking a coordinator to implement a more dynamic offensive approach following recent performance.

🔬 Science

T. rex Growth Revealed: Fossil Study Reveals Surprisingly Long Development Timeline •

A recent study analyzing fossilized Tyrannosaurus rex leg bones has significantly revised estimates of the dinosaur’s growth rate. Researchers utilized advanced imaging techniques to examine growth rings in the bones, revealing that the apex predator required approximately 35 years to reach its full adult size. This is considerably longer than previous estimates based solely on bone circumference measurements. The findings suggest T. rex experienced a prolonged period of rapid growth during its juvenile stage. This new data provides a more accurate understanding of the dinosaur’s lifespan and evolutionary development.

🩺 Health

Measles Cases Surge in Buncombe County: Siblings Confirming Unvaccinated Status •

Two new cases of measles have been identified in Buncombe County, North Carolina, affecting unvaccinated siblings. The children, aged preschool and school-age, are currently under medical observation. One of the children attends Asheville-Pisgah Christian School, prompting increased monitoring within the school community. Health officials are investigating the outbreak and urging vaccination as the primary preventative measure against the highly contagious disease.
